review.body:
Re-reviewed current head `98f14a884be87527f0f5cd9b6b3d90b1d5978fb7`. SECURITY-N/A.

The code-side concerns from my previous review are resolved: matching is now normalized inside `get_import_local()`, output casing is preserved, the unrelated mapping/debug artifacts are gone, and the new regression covers case mismatches through both `package["name"]` and `package["exports"]`.

One evidence/scope blocker remains before I can approve this head: the PR still says `Closes #243`, but the current regression only demonstrates the capitalization failure from #312. #243 reports a concrete `--use-local` run that finds `pyserial`, `PySimpleGUI`, and `PyYAML` and then writes zero requirements; this patch does not reproduce that scenario, so there is still no evidence that case-insensitive matching is sufficient to close it.

Please either add a focused regression that reproduces #243 on `master` and passes with this change, or remove `Closes #243` and keep the PR scoped to the demonstrated #312 fix. The current Actions runs are `action_required` with no jobs, so they also do not yet provide test evidence for this head.
